comments.author: Shirin
comments.body: Emma spices usually sell the best in Northern Europe. Depending on market rate you can get up to 25k on Cloves, Mace, and Nutmeg (higher even if you can haggle well). Pepper can sell up to 15k, while Cinnamon can up to 10k. I haven't tried other spices yet.

comments.author: Theo
comments.body: Cardamom used to be on the same ballpark as pepper pre 2nd age, I haven't tried it ever since.
